title: Leadville Trail 100 Run Camp — 2027 camp dates, ages and camp-plus-entry pricing
claims: The 2027 Leadville Trail 100 Run Camp runs June 17-19, 2027; registration opens December 1, 2026.
Minimum age is 17+ for Run Camp participation and 18+ on race day for the LT100 Run.
Camp + Entry Package registration opens 12/1/26 at $2,200; Camp Only Package registration opens 1/7/27 at $1,000.

The three-day camp covers the LT100 Run course in group day and night runs with veteran-led discussion sessions; the 2026 reference schedule included a Mayqueen-to-store night run, a Mayqueen-to-Twin Lakes day run and a Willis Gulch-to-Hope Pass day run.
